items.name: agent-ui-setup
items.title: Agent UI setup
items.description: Installs @kind-ui/agent-ui, imports its styles and points coding agents at its docs.
items.docs:
Your stylesheet now imports @kind-ui/agent-ui/styles.css. Tailwind finds the copied components itself; if they live outside the app that builds them, add @source "<path to them>"; to that stylesheet.
Coding agents: read the AGENTS.md beside the components before changing them.

items.name: step
items.title: Step
items.description: A collapsible agent step with a status icon.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A run status badge with a mark and a label.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The model's thinking as a step, with its thoughts streamed as markdown.

items.name: tool
items.title: Tool
items.description: A tool call as a step, from its streamed input to its output or error.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of Thought
items.description: A summary of the steps an agent took, which opens into each step's details.

items.name: task
items.title: Task
items.description: The steps an agent takes for a task, as it takes them, with how many are done.

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: The steps an agent plans to take, with a progress bar and an Accept button.

items.name: subagent
items.title: Subagent
items.description: A subagent's run: its own steps, a Stop button and its result.

items.name: queue
items.title: Queue
items.description: The agent's to-do list, queued and completed, that people can reorder and clear.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: Approve or deny an agent's request, with an optional reason, then the recorded outcome.

items.name: question
items.title: Question
items.description: Single choice, multiple choice and free text questions in one form, then the recorded answers.

items.name: checkpoint
items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: A marker in the conversation that restores to that point, after a dialog asks first.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model Selector
items.description: A searchable list of models grouped by provider, with the matching letters marked.

items.name: reasoning-effort
items.title: Reasoning Effort
items.description: How hard the model thinks, as a row of levels with a mark that slides to the chosen one.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: A row of prompts a person can send in one press, which scrolls sideways when they don't fit.

items.name: context-meter
items.title: Context Meter
items.description: How full the context window is, as a ring and a percentage, with token counts and cost in a popover.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: Thumbs up and down for a response, with an optional comment written in a popover.

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: A calm callout for info, success, a warning or an error, with optional actions and Dismiss.

items.name: guardrail-notice
items.title: Guardrail Notice
items.description: Says a guardrail blocked or filtered content, with the policy reason and an expandable detail.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: The sources a response used, as a compact count that opens a list of links.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline Citation
items.description: A marker in running text whose card shows the sources it points to, paging through several.

items.name: document
items.title: Document

items.name: generated-image
items.title: Generated Image
items.description: An image the agent is making, from progress and a blurred preview to the image, which opens full size.

items.title: File Tree
items.description: Changed files as a folder tree, each with its change and the lines it added and removed.

items.description: A command and its output in ANSI colors, following the end as it streams, with its exit code and duration.

items.description: An error's name, message and frames, with library frames folded and each frame able to open its file.

items.title: Selection

items.title: Action
items.description: An action run on selected text as a step, quoting the text above its streamed result.
